subject: unable to reproduce line from stat_smooth

messages.author: 283eace965c099f4
messages.subject: unable to reproduce line from stat_smooth
parts:
Hi, 

I am trying to reproduce a stat_smooth line but somehow it doesn't work. The line is based on the locfit function and code is below. 

# packages
require(locfit)

# sim data
set.seed(123)
n=1000
y=rbinom(n,1,0.5)
x=runif(n)
data=data.frame(x,y)

# fit model
model <- locfit(y~lp(x,h=0.2),data=data,kern="rect",family="binomial",link="logit")
xrange <- range(data$x)
xseq <- seq(from=xrange[1], to=xrange[2], length=80)
pred <- predict(model, newdata = data.frame(x = xseq), se=TRUE)
y_hat = pred$fit
data.locfit=data.frame(x=xseq,y=y_hat)

# figure
ggplot(data,aes(x=x,y=y)) + 
stat_smooth(method="locfit",kern="rect",family="binomial",link="logit",formula = y~lp(x,h=0.2)) + ylim(0,1) + geom_line(data=data.locfit,aes(x=x,y=y))

messages.author: 283eace965c099f4
messages.subject: Re: unable to reproduce line from stat_smooth
parts:
Here is the plot. From all I know, the two lines should be the same but they are not. The blue one is produced by ggplot's stat_smooth and the black one by predicting values from the fitted model. 

Any ideas why they are different?

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: unable to reproduce line from stat_smooth
parts:
Hmmm, my best guess is that it's something to do with the x values -
for stat_smooth they will have been scaled to range c(0, 1)
